headline: Ugro Capital Limited files Scheme of Amalgamation; merger details to regulatory disclosure
sum: Ugro Capital Limited has notified a scheme of amalgamation to the NSE, marking a material restructuring of the NBFC. The filing indicates formal commencement of the merger process; full transaction structure and consideration remain to be disclosed in regulatory filings.
implication: Amalgamation of an NBFC requires coordinated approvals under NCLT, RBI, and stock exchange procedures; counsel must verify NBFC wind-down, deposit/creditor claims protocols, and delisting mechanics.
detail: Ugro Capital Limited, a non-bank financial company, has informed the NSE of an amalgamation/merger scheme on 18 August 2026 via formal stock exchange notification. The NSE filing reference (UGROCAP_18082026193435_CLUgromerged.pdf) confirms the announcement to the exchange. Material details including the acquiring/transferee entity, consideration amount, share exchange ratio, and effective date remain to be disclosed in subsequent regulatory filings, including the NCLT petition and any SEBI/RBI approvals required.
